sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was reduced: full-year 2026 EPS guided to $12.10-$12.30 versus $13.26 in 2025, and operating margin expected to decrease by approximately 250 basis points. Management explicitly guided for North America revenue to decline 1%-3% and acknowledged that 'an improvement in overall trends in North America will likely progress over the course of the year and into 2027.' The gross margin decline of 550 basis points in Q4 and continued margin pressure in 2026, combined with cautious language on the pace of recovery, support a bearish forward outlook.

summary.revenue: Total net revenue $3.6 billion, up 1% (6% excluding 53rd week); constant currency revenue rose 4% and comparable sales increased 2%.
summary.eps: Net income $587 million, $5.01 per diluted share, compared to $6.14 per diluted share in the prior period.
summary.guidance: Full-year 2026 revenue expected $11.35B-$11.5B (2%-4% growth); North America down 1%-3%; China Mainland up ~20%; Rest of World up mid-teens. EPS guided to $12.10-$12.30 versus $13.26 in 2025. Operating margin expected to decrease ~250 bps.
summary.margin: Gross margin 54.9%, down 550 bps from 60.4%; operating margin 22.3% versus 28.9% prior year. Full-year 2026 gross margin expected to decrease ~120 bps, operating margin ~250 bps.
key_risks: Gross margin decreased 550 bps primarily due to 560 bps drop in product margin including 520 bps negative tariff impact and 130 bps higher markdowns.
Operating margin dropped to 22.3% from 28.9% year over year, with continued margin pressure expected in 2026 (full-year decrease of ~250 bps).
North America top-line challenges: management projects regional revenue to decline 1%-3% and acknowledges improvement 'will likely progress over the course of the year and into 2027.'
SG&A as a percentage of revenue increased to 32.5%, with full-year deleverage of ~130 bps expected due to labor, incentive compensation, and proxy contest costs.
Tariffs: gross tariff cost for 2025 was $275M; 2026 forecast calls for $380M gross tariff impact.
key_opportunities: International momentum: China Mainland revenue up 28% with comparable sales up 26%; Rest of World up 12% with 5% comparable sales increase.
Product innovation: new launches (Unrestricted Power, ShowZero, ThermoZen) cited as positively received; new style penetration increased to 35% in North America spring assortment.
Action plan focused on increasing full-price sales via product innovation, SKU reduction, inventory rebalancing, and enhanced marketing; measurable sequential improvements already in Q1.
New store openings returning above 100% ROI with payback periods of less than a year; average sales per square foot exceeding $1,400.
Enterprise efficiency initiatives targeting meaningful savings; $160M in tariff offsets expected within gross margin in 2026.

review_flags.reason: The score of -0.50 is based on reduced forward guidance and cautious language. A reviewer should confirm that the magnitude of the guidance reduction (EPS from $13.26 to $12.10-$12.30) and the explicit North America decline guidance justify this bearish score, and that no offsetting positive signals (e.g., international growth, new product reception) should pull the score higher.
